_comment: Phase 1 pitches ONLY the data hub. Approved figures below are the claim ledger: a draft may cite these numbers and no others. Refresh approvedFigures + updated/nextRelease each month from https://www.companydebt.com/data/uk-insolvency-statistics/ (they are official Insolvency Service + Companies House figures, not proprietary — the moat is the presentation, never claim exclusivity). Phase 2 will add the hub + pillar pages already listed under 'phase2Assets'.
